what: CRITICAL: One Question at a Time (UI Glitch Workaround)
title: Agents
text: Requirement: NEVER ask multiple questions single response. Ask one question per response, whether using AskUser() inline clarifying questions. : UI glitch RStudio/Posit prevents rendering multiple questions single batch. last question visible user. user answers last (visible) question, interface stalls system still waiting answers earlier (hidden) questions. Correct pattern: Incorrect pattern (causes stalling): multiple sequential questions needed: Ask across multiple turns (one per turn), . slower avoids glitch entirely. want batch multiple options one decision: Use single AskUser() call multiple options (buttons), renders correctly. fine — glitch affects multiple questions, multiple options within one question.
code: Turn 1: Ask Question 1 only Turn 2: Wait for answer to Q1, then ask Question 2 only Turn 3: Wait for answer to Q2, then ask Question 3 only Turn 1: Ask Questions 1, 2, 3 all in one response [User sees only Q3, answers it, interface stalls]

text: pressfreedom R package bundling Shiny dashboard exploring Reporters Without Borders (RSF) Press Freedom Index. dashboard three views: Map — choropleth world, colored score/rank/dimension chosen year; low-friction entry point data. Trends — multi-country line charts (Score) bump charts (Rank) 2002–2025. Country — single country’s profile: horizontal Rank/Score stat table, score-band/rank-tier count bar charts, two combined trend charts (Score + dimensions, Rank + dimension ranks) sharing one deduplicated legend. Clicking country Map point Trends chart jumps Country profile (see “Shared navigation” ).

See “Map score/rank bands” . mod_chart (Trends) — renders plotly card, reused two contexts: standalone Trends view (multi-country, show_nav = TRUE) embedded Country view compact mode single country (show_nav = FALSE). Score scale-transition artifact (2013): RSF changed scoring methodology 2013. score exists back 2002, pre-2013 2013+ values sit two incompatible scales — mixing aggregate (mean/median, band counts, min/max) understates overstates real standing. score_evolution (score - score_n_1) additionally compares two scales directly single transition year, producing artifacts large +5,763 aren’t real year--year changes. rank_evolution unaffected (rank -year relative ordering years, regardless underlying score scale). Resolution: mod_country.R’s score stat block (stat_table) score-band bar chart (score_band_data) filter year_n >= 2013 computing anything, score_evolution additionally set NA year_n == 2013 (scoped locally — underlying rwb_standardized$score_evolution column untouched) since even first comparable year’s evolution diff incompatible prior value. use score score_evolution elsewhere multi-year aggregate, apply year_n >= 2013 filter (2013 score_evolution exclusion, using evolution) surface artifact.

what: Nonce collision pitfall: identical values silently skip reactiveVal observers
title: Agents
text: Map Trends modules return list(country = ..., nonce = ...) app-level selected_country reactiveVal. nonce critical — reactiveVal silently skips calling observers assigned identical() value current one. fix (module-local integer counters): module used click_nonce <- 0 incremented 1 click. Clicking country map (nonce = 1) chart (nonce = 1) produced identical() values: silently broke navigation first chart click session (second clicks increment chart nonce beyond 1). Fix: Use .numeric(proc.time()[["elapsed"]]) instead integer counters. elapsed seconds since R process startup globally unique across modules re-executions: Apply pattern new module feeds selected_country reactiveVal needs distinguish repeated values.
code: # map click selected_country(list(country = "Algeria", nonce = 1))  # chart click on same country selected_country(list(country = "Algeria", nonce = 1))  # identical(), observer skipped # map click selected_country(list(country = "Algeria", nonce = 12345.678))  # chart click on same country selected_country(list(country = "Algeria", nonce = 12345.789))  # not identical(), observer fires

what: Client-side JavaScript approach for chart interactivity
title: Agents
text: interactive behavior Trends chart (click--navigate hover-dimming) now handled entirely client-side via JavaScript (htmlwidgets::onRender), rather R-side plotly event handlers plotlyProxy restyle commands. : Early attempts used R-side plotlyProxy() restyle hover dim non-hovered traces. first hover (client-side plotly traces fully initialized), triggered coerceTraceIndices error plotly’s JavaScript. error ran Shiny message batch navigation nav_select() triggered simultaneous click, error aborted entire message batch, silently swallowing navigation command. Current implementation: mod_chart.R’s renderPlotly, onRender callback installs three event listeners: Click--navigate: Extracts country name directly clicked trace (el.data[curveNumber].name, set plot_ly(color=) ggplot aes(color=)), calls Shiny.setInputValue() priority = 'event' ensure every click fires. Hover-dimming: Extracts hovered curveNumber, loops traces, sets opacities 1 hovered trace 0.15 others via Plotly.restyle() — instant, server round-trip. Unhover: Restores traces full opacity. design eliminates timing issue makes hover-dimming snappier. revert plotlyProxy restyle observeEvent(event_data("plotly_hover", ...)) — coerceTraceIndices error return.

what: Trends tooltip content and the bump chart’s legend dedup
title: Agents
text: Trends chart types show 3-line hover tooltip — flag emoji + country name, Year: <n>, Score:/Rank: <value> — built explicit hover_text column (flag_emoji(iso) + country_en + year_n + metric value) rather relying plotly’s default x/y/name hover. score branch native plot_ly(), direct: text = ~hover_text, hoverinfo = "text". rank branch goes ggplot2 + vendored pf_geom_bump() + ggplotly(), constrained: hover_text mapped via ggplot2::aes(text = hover_text) geom_point() (real yearly data points), geom_bump() (stat-transformed, interpolated curve whose intermediate rows aren’t real year/rank pairs — mapping text show misleading values). ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") uses mapping. geom_bump()’s line layer text aes, ggplotly() otherwise show empty/NA hover box hovering connecting curve two yearly points. Fixed identifying line-mode traces post-hoc disabling hover entirely: plotly::style(p_final, hoverinfo = "none", traces = line_traces) line_traces <- (vapply(p_final$x$data, function(tr) identical(tr$mode, "lines"), logical(1))). Fix: decouple legend real traces entirely. plotly::style(p_final, showlegend = FALSE, traces = seq_along(p_final$x$data)) hides legend every real trace, one proxy add_trace() per country supplies single "lines+markers" swatch sized match score chart (marker = list(size = 20), line = list(width = 4)). Proxy trace point placement — use numeric(0) NA: empty vector (x = numeric(0), y = numeric(0)) looks like safest way make proxy trace invisible, plotly::plotly_build() found (empirically) silently corrupt — trace’s x/y end literal strings "x"/"y" instead numeric data, legend entry never renders. scalar NA point opposite problem: plot_ly()’s trace-building drops , along name/legendgroup metadata, since looks like “data mapped”. fix works: real, far---range scalar point (x = -1e6, y = -1e6). ggplotly() already fixes chart’s axis ranges explicitly (autorange = FALSE axes, confirmed via p_final$x$layout), sentinel point simply clipped -canvas fixed range can’t perturb visible plot trigger autorange. hover-dimming fix (grouping trace name/country rather curveNumber, country’s “lines” “markers” sub-traces dim together) lives shared onRender script — see “Client-side JavaScript approach chart interactivity” . add third color-mapped layer chart, re-verify whole proxy-trace setup — new real trace changes trace ggplotly() otherwise pick showlegend = TRUE, though explicit style(showlegend = FALSE, ...) real traces absorb automatically. Legend entry order sorted match curves’ vertical position final year: ascending rank (best rank first, since scale_y_reverse() puts “best” top) — rank-axis mirror score branch’s descending--value sort, already place change. bump chart’s start/end geom_text(label = iso) layers (ISO codes ends curve) removed legend took identifying curve country.

what: “Deselect all” clobbering a just-restored partial selection on metric switch
title: Agents
text: Symptom (reported, reproduced, fixed): customize Score partial selection (e.g. “Good”), switch Rank customize (e.g. “Top 2.5%”), switch back Score — just-restored partial selection got silently overwritten back “everything checked” (countries colored). Confusingly, appeared asymmetric: sometimes Score revisit failed Rank revisit succeeded, sometimes reverse — depending metric user recently used “Deselect ” checkbox switching away . Root cause: “Deselect ” checkbox (input$deselect_all) stateful toggle — checking clears every band, unchecking restores full set — implemented via observeEvent(input$deselect_all, ...) unconditionally calling updateCheckboxGroupInput(..., selected = (checked) character(0) else levels_). Separately, code needs keep toggle’s displayed value honest side effect actions (e.g. syncing unchecked user manually re-checks one band using “Deselect ”, resetting metric-change observer restores saved non-empty selection). side effects work calling shiny::updateCheckboxInput(session, "deselect_all", value = ...). updateCheckboxInput() changing value indistinguishable, inside input$deselect_all observer, genuine user click — programmatic “sync display unchecked” call immediately retrigger observer’s full-reset logic, overwriting selection triggered sync (e.g. metric-change observer’s just-applied restore). Fix: deselect_all_tracked reactiveVal records value module recently assigned input$deselect_all (whether via genuine user click programmatic sync). Every programmatic updateCheckboxInput(session, "deselect_all", value = X) call preceded deselect_all_tracked(X). observeEvent(input$deselect_all, ...) handler opens (identical(input$deselect_all, deselect_all_tracked())) return(invisible(NULL)) — update’s echo arrives client, ’s recognised module’s destructive reset skipped; value differs deselect_all_tracked() (real, new user click) runs reset logic. input$bands observer also gained matching sync block (see comment ) fix closely-related “Deselect stays checked user manually re-checks band” bug — guard, reactiveVal. remove deselect_all_tracked “unwrap” unnecessary indirection — every one do_reset_map(), metric-change observer, input$bands sync block relies make updateCheckboxInput() calls silent -ops input$deselect_all observer’s point view.
